composedOf.label: composed of
composedOf.means: A statblock is built from a pooled rule (an attack, a trait); the rule lists the statblocks that use it.

belongsTo.label: belongs to
belongsTo.means: A statblock belongs to one creature; the creature reads its numbers from it.

stageOf.label: stage of
stageOf.means: A condition is a stage of another (exhaustion 3 of exhaustion); the base condition lists its stages.

affects.label: affects
affects.means: A rule changes another rule (a feat that alters grappling); the changed rule lists what affects it.
affects.intended: Apply the change in play: when the source rule is active, the effect it names should alter the target rule’s numbers or text where the target is used.

worships.label: worships
worships.means: A creature or faction worships a deity; the deity lists its worshippers.

casts.label: casts
casts.means: A statblock, character, item, subclass, ancestry or feat can cast a spell; the spell lists who casts it.
casts.intended: Feed the spell list and its uses: mode, uses, level and charges should appear on the sheet as castable, with slots and charges counted down in play.

equips.label: equips
equips.means: A statblock has an item equipped; the item lists who wears or wields it.
equips.intended: Count equipped items: armour and shields should set AC, weapons should become attacks on the statblock.

subclassOf.label: subclass of
subclassOf.means: A subclass belongs to one class; the class lists its subclasses.

subraceOf.label: subrace of
subraceOf.means: An ancestry is a subrace of another; the parent lists its subraces.
subraceOf.intended: Inherit from the parent: a subrace should bring what its parent ancestry grants, and the builder should offer it under the parent.

hasClass.label: class
hasClass.means: A player character has levels in a class; the class lists who took it.

hasAncestry.label: ancestry
hasAncestry.means: A player character has one ancestry; the ancestry lists the characters of it.

hasBackground.label: background
hasBackground.means: A player character has one background; the background lists the characters with it.

allowsMethod.label: allows ability method
allowsMethod.means: A campaign allows a way of determining ability scores; the method lists the campaigns that allow it.

allowsEquipment.label: allows equipment method
allowsEquipment.means: A campaign allows a way of getting starting equipment; the method lists the campaigns that allow it.

abilityPool.label: rolled ability pool
abilityPool.means: A party has rolled a pool of ability scores with a method; the method lists the parties that rolled with it.

chose.label: chose
chose.means: A player character answered a choice (a skill, a feat, a subclass); the source of the choice lists who chose from it.

grants.label: grants
grants.means: A class, subclass, ancestry, background or feat grants a feature, from a level on; the feature lists what grants it.

hasProperty.label: has property
hasProperty.means: A weapon, armour or item has a property (finesse, heavy); the property lists the items that have it.
hasProperty.intended: Use the property in numbers: finesse should let an attack use DEX, heavy and two-handed should show on the attack.

owes.label: owes
owes.means: A creature owes another something (a favour, a debt); the creditor lists who owes it.

memberOf.label: member of
memberOf.means: A creature is a member of a faction, at a rank; the faction lists its members.

livesIn.label: lives in
livesIn.means: A creature lives in a place; the place lists its residents.

partOf.label: part of
partOf.means: An article is part of a larger one (a room of a house, a scene of an arc, a book of a group); the larger one lists what it contains, in rank order.

chapterOf.label: chapter of
chapterOf.means: A chapter is read as a chapter of a story (the arc of an adventure); the story lists the chapters that read it.

controls.label: controls
controls.means: A faction controls a place; the place lists who controls it.

describedIn.label: described in
describedIn.means: An article is described in another article; that one lists what it describes.

memberOfParty.label: in the party
memberOfParty.means: A creature is in a party; the party lists its members.

partyOf.label: party of
partyOf.means: A party plays in one campaign; the campaign lists its parties.

carries.label: carries
carries.means: A creature, party or item carries one inventory; the inventory knows who carries it.

holds.label: holds
holds.means: An inventory holds an item, with quantity and place in the grid; the item lists where it is held.

questGiver.label: given by
questGiver.means: A quest is given by a creature or faction; they list the quests they give.

questAbout.label: concerns
questAbout.means: A quest concerns an article; the article lists the quests about it.

happensAt.label: happens at
happensAt.means: A story happens at a place; the place lists the scenes there.

features.label: features
features.means: A story features a creature, statblock or faction; they list the stories they appear in.

knowledge.label: knowledge about it
knowledge.means: An article has a piece of information about it; the information says what it is about.

knownBy.label: known by
knownBy.means: Information or knowledge is known by a creature, party or faction (from a rank); they list what they know.

includes.label: includes
includes.means: A bundle of knowledge includes a piece of information; the information lists the bundles it is part of.

mapOf.label: map of
mapOf.means: A map shows a place or story; the place lists its maps.

insideMap.label: inside
insideMap.means: A map lies inside another map, at a rectangle; the outer map lists what you can zoom into.

marker.label: marker
marker.means: A map has a marker for an article, at a point; the article lists the maps it is marked on.

zone.label: zone
zone.means: A map has a zone of a kind (difficult terrain, darkness); the zone kind lists where it lies.
zone.intended: Draw on the map screen and count it: a zone should change movement and sight where it lies.

territory.label: territory
territory.means: A map shows an article’s territory as a shape; the article lists where it holds ground.
territory.intended: Draw on the map screen: the shape in its colour over the map.

needs.label: needs
needs.means: A recipe needs an item, in a quantity; the item lists the recipes that use it.
needs.intended: Check at the workbench: crafting should require and, where consumed, use up the needed items from the crafter’s inventory.

yields.label: yields
yields.means: A recipe yields one item; the item lists the recipe that makes it.
yields.intended: Deliver at the workbench: a finished crafting should put the item into the crafter’s inventory.

craftsWith.label: crafts with
craftsWith.means: A campaign, party or creature crafts a recipe — or every recipe of a tool — with another tool, ability or DC than the source says; the recipe or tool lists who does.

placed.label: on the board
placed.means: A board has an article placed on it as a card; the article lists the boards it lies on.

participates.label: in the fight
participates.means: An encounter has a creature, statblock or party in the fight, with initiative and hit points; they list the fights they are in.

onMap.label: fought on
onMap.means: An encounter or story is fought on a map; the map lists what is fought there.

loot.label: loot
loot.means: An encounter, story or quest has loot (an item, information, a feat), with quantity and chance; the loot lists where it is found.
loot.intended: Roll and hand out: finishing the encounter should roll the chance and offer the loot to the party’s inventory or knowledge.

involves.label: involves
involves.means: An event involves an article; the article lists the events it took part in.

entry.label: entry
entry.means: A table has an entry, with a weight; the entry lists the tables it can be rolled on.
entry.intended: Roll on the table: the weights should decide which entry a roll lands on.

tableFor.label: rolls on
tableFor.means: A place, story, encounter or character option rolls on a table; the table lists where it is used.

route.label: leads to
route.means: A place leads to another, with travel hours and terrain; the other lists where it is reached from.
route.intended: Travel: moving the party along a route should advance the watch and day counters by its hours.

signal.title: What you sense on the way

inLayer.label: from
inLayer.means: An article comes from a layer (a book, the campaign, homebrew); the layer lists what it brings.

inWorld.label: in the world
inWorld.means: A campaign plays in one world; the world lists its campaigns.
inWorld.intended: Share the world: the campaign should read its calendar and history from this world.

activates.label: Layers in play
activates.means: A campaign puts a layer in play, in an order and mode; the layer lists the campaigns it is in play in.

instanceOf.label: instance of
instanceOf.means: A statblock or item is an instance of a template and stores only what differs; the template lists its instances.

variantOf.label: variant of
variantOf.means: An article is a variant of another (an adopted or adapted copy); the original lists its variants.

overrides.label: replaces
overrides.means: A version replaces another article wherever its layer is in play; the replaced one lists what replaces it.

crafting.label: working on
crafting.means: A creature or party is working on a recipe, with days and rolls so far; the recipe lists who works on it.

regards.label: regards
regards.means: A creature, party or faction regards another, in words (trusts, fears); the other lists who judges it — the reverse is its own edge.
